ios.desc:
IRL is a social app where every connection is made in person. No adding strangers. No sliding into DMs. If you want someone on your friend list, you have to actually meet them.

Every post takes two — You can't post alone. Send an IRL request when you're together, both confirm, and snap a photo to mark the moment. One per friend, per day. Make it count.

Your IRL score is proof — No follower counts. No clout metrics. Your IRL score reflects how often you actually show up in real life. It's not a number you can fake — it's earned face-to-face.

Hardcore mode — The ultimate flex. Turn it on and your account lives or dies by how often you meet up in real life. Stop showing up, lose your account. No lurking. No pretending. Only for people who actually live like this.

Free forever — No ads. No data selling. Just an app that rewards you for the relationships you're already building.

Your friends list should mean something. This is IRL.

quotes.title: Social app that proves you met IRL. Skip 3 days, get deleted
